name: SD card module
author: Bench Workshop
description: A micro-SD card module (SPI) for keeping data: log readings to a file, read them back. The card holds its files while the run lasts (stop the run and it's a fresh card; its files are listed in the run panel). Includes SD.h.

parts.name: SD card module
parts.description: SPI: CS to any pin (SD.begin(CS)), SCK, MOSI, MISO to the board's SPI pins; VCC (5 V, it has its own 3.3 V regulator) and GND. #include <SD.h>; File f = SD.open("log.txt", FILE_WRITE); f.println(value); f.close();

examples.name: Data logger
examples.description: Logs the knob's reading to log.csv twice a second; every 10 lines it reads the whole file back and prints it. Press Run and turn the knob.
